text.zh-CN: 产后出血是分娩后失血过多，可迅速影响血液循环。正常产后恶露是逐渐减少的阴道排出物，不能把突然大量出血一概当作正常恶露。
text.en: Postpartum hemorrhage is excessive bleeding after childbirth that can rapidly impair circulation. Normal lochia, the postpartum vaginal discharge, should gradually diminish; sudden heavy bleeding should not be assumed normal.

text.en: It may occur immediately after delivery or after going home. UK RCOG and US Cleveland Clinic material describe primary PPH within 24 hours of birth and secondary or delayed PPH as abnormal heavy bleeding after 24 hours and up to 12 weeks.

text.zh-CN: 子宫收缩不足时，胎盘剥离处的血管不能被有效压紧；胎盘组织残留也会影响恢复。
text.en: An inadequately contracting uterus fails to compress vessels at the placental attachment site; retained placental tissue can also interfere with recovery.

text.zh-CN: 产道裂伤、胎盘异常附着或凝血问题可导致持续出血；晚些发生的出血还可能与子宫感染有关。
text.en: Birth-canal injury, abnormal placental attachment or clotting problems may cause ongoing bleeding; delayed bleeding can involve uterine infection.

text.zh-CN: 既往产后出血、贫血、多胎、胎盘位置异常或使用抗凝药会改变分娩准备。贫血可以提前发现处理，但不能消除所有风险。
text.en: Previous hemorrhage, anemia, multiple pregnancy, abnormal placental location or anticoagulants affect birth planning. Treating anemia helps preparation without removing all risk.

supports.assessment: Specified risk factors and antenatal preparation.

text.zh-CN: 胎盘迟迟未娩出时称为胎盘滞留；胎盘已经娩出但有部分组织留在子宫内则是胎盘残留，两者需要医生分别判断。凝血缺陷是血液形成稳定血块的能力受损：它可以是原有的问题，也可能在严重失血过程中出现或加重，使出血更难停止。
text.en: A retained placenta has failed to deliver; retained placental tissue means some tissue remains in the uterus after placental delivery. Clinicians assess these separately. A clotting defect impairs the blood’s ability to form stable clots: it may predate birth or develop or worsen during severe blood loss, making bleeding harder to stop.

supports.assessment: 胎盘滞留/残留分别处理；出血丢失凝血成分和病因互相影响。

text.en: In obstructed labour, a barrier prevents the baby from progressing through the birth canal. Subsequent bleeding may involve poor uterine contraction or a tear in the uterine wall, called uterine rupture; these need separate assessment.

text.zh-CN: 医疗人员同时测量失血、监测循环并寻找出血原因，检查和治疗常并行。
text.en: Clinicians measure loss, monitor circulation and identify the source while treatment often proceeds at the same time.

text.zh-CN: 会反复测脉搏、血压及症状，检查子宫收缩、胎盘是否完整和产道伤口，并抽血评估贫血、凝血及备血。
text.en: Pulse, blood pressure and symptoms are reassessed; uterine contraction, placental completeness and injuries are checked, with blood tests for anemia, clotting and transfusion preparation.

text.zh-CN: WHO2025把更早启动治疗与传统失血分类区分开：在产后24小时内，客观失血达到300毫升并伴异常循环体征，或达到500毫升，就应启动首轮处理，以先出现者为准。300毫升加异常体征的早识别方向也得到EBCOG2025评述支持。这是医疗机构的治疗触发条件，不是家庭观察目标。
text.en: WHO 2025 distinguishes an earlier treatment trigger from traditional blood-loss categories: within 24 hours after birth, initiate first response at measured loss of 300 mL with abnormal circulatory signs, or 500 mL, whichever occurs first. EBCOG’s 2025 commentary also supports the 300 mL-plus-abnormal-signs approach. This is a clinical treatment trigger, not a home observation target.

text.zh-CN: 中国2023指南的传统定义为分娩后24小时内阴道分娩失血达到500毫升、剖宫产达到1000毫升，或出现低血容量症状或体征；英国RCOG较早患者资料采用24小时内至少500毫升。各口径的用途和人群不同，不能用较高数字推迟急救；肉眼估计或家用卫生巾不能精确换算毫升。
text.en: China’s 2023 guideline defines PPH within 24 hours as at least 500 mL after vaginal birth, at least 1000 mL after caesarean birth, or symptoms or signs of hypovolemia. Older UK RCOG patient material uses at least 500 mL within 24 hours. These definitions have different purposes and populations; higher numbers must not delay emergency care, and visual estimates or home pads do not precisely convert to milliliters.

text.zh-CN: WHO早识别阈值的证据主要来自阴道分娩，剖宫产资料较少。医生仍须结合手术情况、持续出血、生命体征和原有贫血判断；数字也不直接决定是否手术。
text.en: Evidence for the WHO early trigger comes mainly from vaginal births, with less caesarean evidence. Clinicians still consider the operation, ongoing bleeding, vital signs and existing anemia; a number alone does not determine surgery.

text.zh-CN: 严重持续出血时，凝血检查不只看是否贫血，还会反复评估血小板、凝血时间和纤维蛋白原（帮助形成血块的蛋白质）；有条件时可使用更快反映凝血过程的床旁检查。结果帮助选择治疗，仍需同时寻找胎盘、产道损伤或宫缩等原因。
text.en: With severe ongoing bleeding, tests assess more than anemia: platelets, clotting times and fibrinogen, a protein that helps form clots, are repeatedly checked. Where available, bedside tests can provide faster information about clot formation. Results guide treatment while the team also looks for placental problems, injuries or poor uterine contraction.

text.zh-CN: 产后阴道出血需要结合时间、变化和全身表现区分。
text.en: Timing, trend and general symptoms help distinguish postpartum bleeding problems.

text.zh-CN: 正常恶露通常逐渐减少、颜色变暗；突然增多或伴不适需要重新评估。
text.en: Normal lochia generally decreases and darkens; renewed heavy flow or illness needs reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 较晚出血可能来自感染或残留胎盘组织，常需要检查并采取相应治疗，不只是补血。
text.en: Delayed bleeding may reflect infection or retained placental tissue requiring specific treatment, not simply iron replacement.

text.zh-CN: 头晕、心慌、气短也可能与贫血或其他产后并发症有关；胸痛或呼吸困难仍按急症处理，不能只归因于疲劳。
text.en: Dizziness, palpitations or breathlessness may involve anemia or other postpartum complications. Chest pain or breathing difficulty remains an emergency rather than ordinary tiredness.

text.zh-CN: 处理目标是尽快控制出血、维持重要器官供血并针对原因治疗。
text.en: Treatment aims to control bleeding, preserve organ circulation and address the cause.

text.zh-CN: 裂伤需要修补，残留组织可能需要清除；持续出血时可使用宫腔球囊压迫、介入栓塞或手术。
text.en: Tears need repair and retained tissue may need removal; persistent bleeding may require balloon pressure, embolization or surgery.

text.zh-CN: 大量失血可能需要输血；极少数无法控制的出血需切除子宫以挽救生命。选择取决于出血源、反应和现场资源。
text.en: Major loss may require transfusion. Rare uncontrolled bleeding needs hysterectomy to save life; choices depend on the source, response and available facilities.

text.zh-CN: 胎盘未娩出并伴出血时，可能需要由专业人员取出胎盘，并按情况安排麻醉和镇痛。凝血异常时，止住出血源和补充缺少的血液成分常要同时进行：红细胞主要帮助运送氧气，血浆、血小板或补充纤维蛋白原则承担不同的止血任务，并不是所有人都需要全部使用。
text.en: If the placenta has not delivered and bleeding occurs, professionals may need to remove it with appropriate anesthesia and pain relief. With a clotting abnormality, controlling the bleeding source and replacing missing blood components often proceed together: red cells mainly carry oxygen, while plasma, platelets or fibrinogen replacement have different roles in clotting. Not everyone needs every component.

text.zh-CN: 缩宫素等促宫缩药帮助子宫压紧血管；氨甲环酸帮助减少血块被过快分解，不是促宫缩药，两者角色不同。

text.zh-CN: 预防用药和已发生出血后的救治不同。WHO2025不建议把氨甲环酸常规用于所有阴道或剖宫产的出血预防，但它仍有治疗角色。
text.en: Prevention differs from treatment. WHO 2025 does not recommend routine tranexamic acid prevention for every vaginal or cesarean birth, while retaining its treatment role.

text.zh-CN: 麦角类促宫缩药可能升高血压，有高血压特别是严重高血压或子痫前期者须由团队另选方案。卡前列素可引起支气管收缩，英国NICE建议哮喘者避免使用，药品说明书也有哮喘警示。提前告知这些病史、凝血问题和抗凝药；急救用药由专业人员给药，不能自行注射。
text.en: Ergot uterotonics can raise blood pressure, so hypertension—especially severe hypertension or preeclampsia—requires the team to choose appropriately. Carboprost can narrow the airways: UK NICE advises avoiding it in asthma, and the product label also warns about asthma. Report these conditions, clotting problems and anticoagulants; emergency medicines are administered by professionals, not self-injected.

text.zh-CN: 对已确诊的急性产后出血，WHO2025及中国2023指南支持尽早静脉使用氨甲环酸，并强调出生后3小时内的时间窗。这里从婴儿出生计时，不是从发现出血计时；不能把该方案直接套用于几天或几周后的晚期出血。
text.en: For diagnosed acute PPH, WHO 2025 and China’s 2023 guideline support early intravenous tranexamic acid, emphasizing the window within 3 hours of birth. The clock starts at birth, not when bleeding is noticed; this regimen must not simply be applied to delayed bleeding days or weeks later.

text.zh-CN: 促宫缩药不能替代胎盘问题的处理。氨甲环酸也不能补回已经缺少的血小板或凝血因子；是否补充血液成分由团队结合持续出血和检查结果决定。
text.en: Uterotonics do not replace management of a placental problem. Tranexamic acid does not replace missing platelets or clotting factors; the team decides on blood components using ongoing bleeding and test results.

text.zh-CN: 饮食在稳定后帮助恢复体力和铁储备，不能止住正在发生的大量出血。
text.en: Once stable, food supports energy and iron recovery; it cannot stop active major hemorrhage.

text.zh-CN: 清醒且团队允许后，恢复有蛋白质和铁来源的饮食，例如肉类、豆类及深色叶菜；是否需要额外限制取决于手术和合并疾病。
text.en: When awake and cleared to eat, include protein and iron sources such as meat, pulses and leafy greens, with restrictions based on surgery or other illness.

text.zh-CN: 明显缺铁或贫血通常还需口服或静脉铁，不能仅靠红糖水或补汤恢复。
text.en: Significant iron deficiency or anemia may need oral or intravenous iron; sweet drinks or restorative soups alone are insufficient.

text.zh-CN: 正在急救或可能麻醉时，按团队安排进食饮水，不因准备食物延误转诊。
text.en: During emergency care or possible anesthesia, follow the team's intake instructions rather than delaying transfer for food.

text.zh-CN: 回家后的重点是观察恢复、按治疗方案补铁，并安排实际照护支持。
text.en: At home, monitor recovery, follow iron treatment and arrange practical support.

text.zh-CN: 记录出血量变化、是否出现血块、气味、头晕和体力情况，复诊时带上出院记录。
text.en: Record bleeding trend, clots, odor, dizziness and stamina, and take discharge information to review.

text.zh-CN: 让家人协助照顾婴儿和家务，按恢复情况逐步活动。若明显虚弱，可把有人陪伴、协助洗澡和外出写进家庭照护安排；这是实际支持，不能替代恶化时就医。
text.en: Ask family to help with the baby and household work, and resume activity gradually as recovery allows. If very weak, include company and help with bathing or going out in the household care plan; practical support does not replace assessment when symptoms worsen.

text.zh-CN: 产后出血本身通常不妨碍继续哺乳，可请求哺乳和情绪支持。若需要住院治疗，也可与团队讨论婴儿照护和喂养安排；新发危险信号仍按前述标准求助。
text.en: PPH itself usually does not prevent continued breastfeeding, and feeding and emotional support are available. If admission is needed, discuss infant care and feeding arrangements with the team; new warning signs still require the help described above.

text.zh-CN: 既往病史影响失血耐受程度和急救准备，需在分娩前说清楚。
text.en: Medical history changes tolerance of blood loss and emergency preparation and should be discussed before birth.

text.zh-CN: 已有贫血者更难承受进一步失血，应尽早评估和治疗；严重贫血或口服铁无法耐受时可讨论静脉铁。
text.en: Existing anemia reduces reserve and needs early assessment and treatment; intravenous iron may be discussed for severe anemia or poor oral tolerance.

text.zh-CN: 胎盘位置或附着异常、曾有大出血、凝血病或正在用抗凝药者，需制定适合的分娩场所和备血计划。
text.en: Abnormal placenta, previous major hemorrhage, bleeding disorders or anticoagulants warrant birth-setting and blood-product planning.

text.zh-CN: 对输血有特殊要求、合并哮喘或高血压者，应提前记录，以帮助急救时选择血液制品和药物。
text.en: Record transfusion preferences, asthma and hypertension in advance to guide emergency blood-product and medicine choices.

text.zh-CN: 已知遗传性出血病者，计划再次怀孕时应与血液科和产科共同讨论照护；如果是血友病A或B携带者，产后出院后也应保持专科联系，由团队结合凝血因子检测安排后续处理。
text.en: With a known inherited bleeding disorder, discuss care jointly with hematology and obstetrics when planning another pregnancy. If you carry hemophilia A or B, remain in specialist contact after postpartum discharge, with continuing care guided by clotting-factor tests.

text.zh-CN: 出血停止后，身体和情绪恢复还需要时间。
text.en: Physical and emotional recovery continue after bleeding stops.

text.zh-CN: 疲劳和贫血可能持续数周，复诊会看症状与血常规，并决定铁治疗是否继续。
text.en: Fatigue and anemia may last weeks; review assesses symptoms and blood counts to guide ongoing iron treatment.

text.zh-CN: 可以请团队解释原因、使用过的药物或手术及未来妊娠安排；焦虑、噩梦或持续难以应付时也值得寻求帮助。
text.en: Ask the team to explain the cause, medicines or procedures and future pregnancy planning. Anxiety, nightmares or persistent difficulty coping also deserve support.

text.zh-CN: 既往产后出血增加下一次分娩的风险，应在再次怀孕时主动告知，提前准备，但并非一定会再次发生。
text.en: Previous hemorrhage increases risk at a future birth, so disclose it early in another pregnancy; recurrence is not inevitable.

text.zh-CN: 曾发生子宫破裂而保留子宫者，今后妊娠存在再次破裂风险；计划再次怀孕时，应带上手术记录，与产科讨论后续妊娠及分娩方案。
text.en: If the uterus was preserved after rupture, a future pregnancy carries a risk of another rupture. When planning pregnancy, take the operative records to an obstetric consultation to discuss pregnancy and birth planning.

text.zh-CN: 大出血的后果取决于失血程度和是否及时控制。
text.en: Consequences depend on the amount lost and how promptly bleeding is controlled.

text.zh-CN: 常见后续问题是贫血和疲劳；严重失血可引起休克，即循环不足，进而损伤重要器官。
text.en: Anemia and fatigue are common aftereffects. Severe loss can cause shock, inadequate circulation that may damage vital organs.

text.zh-CN: 个别患者需要子宫切除，这会影响以后怀孕；经历也可能造成明显心理创伤。
text.en: Some patients need hysterectomy, affecting future pregnancy; psychological trauma may also follow.

text.zh-CN: 产后出血、尤其严重出血或输血后也需评估血栓风险。医生会在出血已经控制、必要时凝血异常得到纠正后，权衡抗凝等预防措施；出院时应明确是否用药及何时复核。不要仅因曾经出血就自行改变处方；若再次大量出血应立即求助。
text.en: Clot risk also needs assessment after PPH, particularly severe bleeding or transfusion. After bleeding is controlled and any coagulopathy corrected, clinicians weigh anticoagulants and other preventive measures; clarify the medication and review plan at discharge. Do not change a prescription solely because bleeding happened before; recurrent heavy bleeding requires immediate help.
